$comment: Number formats (GAME_DESIGN 18.3, E.12; decision 64): the tokens web/js/fmt.js words a number with its unit by, each approved once, so a height or a mile reads the same on every phone and never in its locale. fmt.js fills the number (ASCII digits, a comma every three, a point before tenths); web/js/text.js shows a format's spaces as no-break spaces, so the number never breaks from its unit. S5 has two, both the trail frame's; S6 adds a percentage (and one under the least shown), a distance in miles, a clock time in the morning and in the afternoon, and a span of minutes, for the odds, the Why sheet and an outcome's pencil rows; dates join with their sessions. Drafts until B004 is answered; preview only.

fmt.ft.ctx: A height in feet: the trail caption's elevation, 4,900 ft (12.2). Never broken across a row

fmt.mile_marker.ctx: The strip's mile marker: how far along today's route you are, mi 6.9 (12.2). Never broken across a row

fmt.pct.ctx: A percentage: an odds tag's made-it (65%), a fail or fatal share, a Why-sheet figure (8.1). Never broken across a row

fmt.pct_under.ctx: A share under the least a tag shows: <0.1% fatal, never 0 (8.1)

fmt.mi.ctx: A distance in miles, one decimal: 3.4 mi (the Why sheet's route, 12.11)

fmt.clock_am.ctx: A morning clock time, to the nearest minute: 11:05 am

fmt.clock_pm.ctx: An afternoon clock time, to the nearest minute: 4:26 pm (noon is 12:00 pm)

fmt.min.ctx: A span of minutes: 20 min (an outcome's pencil row, Time +20 min)
